$comment: Print My Design palette. Core hues sampled directly from the supplied logo mark (warm peak #F1AB3C, cool peak #2A629B); tints/shades and neutrals derived from those two anchors.

print-orange.role: Primary accent. Gradient start. CTAs, highlight words, rules.

print-orange-deep.role: Pressed/hover state, shadow side of the mark, small text on white.

print-blue.role: Primary cool. Gradient end. Headers, links on paper.

print-blue-bright.role: Lifted blue for hover, charts, secondary buttons on dark.

ink.role: Primary dark ground. Ad backgrounds, dark-mode email.

paper.role: Email body ground. Warm white, not pure.

proof.role: Verified/receipt/proof callouts. Always blue - proof is never orange.

urgency.role: Deadlines, ends-tonight, low stock. Always the deep orange, never red.

signature.rule: Only ever on the logo mark, a full-bleed hero wash, or a 4px top rule. Never behind body copy.

contrast_notes.print-orange on white: 1.9:1 - FAILS. Never orange text on white. Use print-orange-deep on white for large text only, or ink text with an orange underline.
contrast_notes.print-blue on white: 6.1:1 - safe for body text and links
contrast_notes.print-blue on ink: 2.6:1 - FAILS on dark. Use print-blue-bright (5.4:1) on ink instead.
contrast_notes.ink on print-orange: 10.8:1 - safe. This is the preferred CTA button: ink text on an orange fill.
